description: This file contains formatting functions for session tokens, durations, cache stats, and runtime status, used in status display components.

methods.name: formatKTokens
methods.description: Formats a number of tokens into a 'k' notation, e.g., 1500 -> '1.5k'.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a precise string, or 'unknown' if invalid.

methods.name: formatTokensCompact
methods.description: Creates a compact string representation of session token usage, including cache info.

methods.name: formatPromptCacheCompact
methods.description: Creates a compact string summarizing cache hit rate and read/write stats.

methods.name: resolvePromptCacheStats
methods.description: Calculates cache read/write stats and hit rate from session data.

methods.name: formatDaemonRuntimeShort
methods.description: Formats a short status string for a daemon runtime, including status, pid, state, and details.
